column1: # Windows 7 allowlist for tools\win7_check.ps1: every import of the shipped binaries verified to exist on Windows 7 SP1
# (each function's "Minimum supported client" is Windows 7 or older; ws2_32 by ordinal = the Winsock 1/2 core, stable
# since Windows 95; comctl32 #345 = TaskDialogIndirect, Vista+ with the Common-Controls 6 manifest). Seeded 29 Oct 2026
# from FLvibed.dll, FLvibed-Setup.exe and flvibed_server.dll at bfa4ee7, reviewed by hand. Add a line only after
# checking the function's documentation; a newer function is resolved at run time instead. '*' = a non-Windows DLL.
# 30 Oct 2026, WORK_QUEUE Q5 slice 1: SDL3 3.4.18 static in the controller host (68 imports the 29 Oct measurement listed
# + SetEnvironmentVariableA / SwitchToThread of sdlpad.cpp). 7 of the 70 looked up one by one, the other 63 allowlisted
# as long-standing Windows 2000 / XP API without a per-function look-up (the header's rule bent: a FLVIBED_SIM_WIN7 run
# passed 30 Oct; a real Windows 7 machine is J5) (looked up on learn.microsoft.com this day: CM_Get_Parent "Windows 2000", SHGetFolderPathW "Windows 2000 / XP",
# SystemTimeToTzSpecificLocalTime "Windows 2000"; the rest are the classic Win32 core - threads, TLS, events, pipes,
# overlapped I/O, the message loop, window classes, timers, device notifications - documented as Windows 2000 / XP).
# The CM_* functions come through setupapi.lib: setupapi.dll exports them (forwarded to cfgmgr32 on Windows 10 / 11);
# SDL calls them from HIDAPI's device enumeration (src\hidapi\windows\hid.c) and WGI (off by hint). SDL loads XInput, hid.dll,
# cfgmgr32's notifications (Windows 8+, skipped on 7), combase and gameinput.dll at run time with fallbacks.
